design_rule: Policy-specific treatment requires documented source-component attribution, relevant decision/implementation timing, and a justified counterfactual design. These are not established here; diagnostic support is assessed separately.
inference: none; no new counterfactual, adjusted effect, SE, CI or p-value
interpretation: NOT identified with currently assembled evidence. Convex-hull failure limits this particular interpolation design, not every possible method.
limitations: A legal provision's tax-period rule does not attribute the author's composite flag.
The three-variable WDI donor-hull check is not formal positivity or full covariate support.
The matching risk sets condition on donor future tax cuts and full follow-up WID outcomes.
DPI political history completeness does not imply political covariate balance.
Pre-period slope diagnostics cannot establish parallel counterfactual trends.
Events reuse treated and donor countries; pair counts are not independent units.
pretrend_definition: Observed pre-period income-share slope gap for macro-selected donors under the earlier reference selection; not a proof of parallel trends.
